name: New Zealand
shortSummary: India and New Zealand maintain warm but modest ties, with ongoing negotiations toward a free trade agreement and a growing Indian-origin population in New Zealand.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: A growing Indian-origin population and student community in New Zealand.
New Zealand dairy exporters have long sought greater market access in India.

majorChallenges.title: Stalled FTA talks
majorChallenges.description: Free trade agreement negotiations have proceeded slowly since first launching in 2010.

recentDevelopments.title: Renewed trade agreement talks
recentDevelopments.description: India and New Zealand continued discussions toward a bilateral free trade agreement, building on talks that first launched in 2010.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Modest but real momentum in a relationship that has historically moved slowly.

historicalEvents.title: Renewed Trade Negotiations
historicalEvents.description: India and New Zealand hold renewed discussions toward a bilateral free trade agreement after talks first launched in 2010.
